why_choose_us.title: Back on the floor in an hour
why_choose_us.description: Fibrecrete-G cures in an hour or less. The aisle you shut down in the morning is carrying forklifts again before lunch.

why_choose_us.title: It flexes instead of cracking
why_choose_us.description: Rigid cementitious patches fail the moment the slab moves. Our system flexes with expansion, contraction and heavy wheel loads, so the repair does not become next year's repair.

why_choose_us.title: We install in the cold
why_choose_us.description: Low-temperature cure means winter is not a reason to defer the work, and freezer and cold-storage floors are a specialism rather than an exception.

why_choose_us.title: Women-owned, Mid-Atlantic based
why_choose_us.description: Run out of Northeastern Pennsylvania and working across six states, with a women-owned structure that qualifies for national-account diversity programs.
